fact: The social affairs minister said at the 10 April 2026 inauguration of the RSU headquarters that the universal health insurance, safety net and insertion programmes now have the RSU as a common source of information.

A flood-preparedness workshop on 27-28 January 2026 reported that survey data collected in five Talangai districts were migrated to the PSIPJ general beneficiary register and that a test payment to a sample of beneficiaries was made through that register.
